repo_url.description: Optional; the registry supplies the source repository URL. If provided, it must match that repository.

version.description: Optional unprefixed semantic version; must match the release tag after stripping its leading v.

target.description: Execution side for this DLL plugin: server-only, client-only, or shared by both. Omitted values default to shared. This is plugin metadata, not a pak manifest.

mod_dependencies.description: Required pak mods, validated against package_db. At most one dependency per repository; registry validation checks case-insensitive uniqueness.

plugin_dependencies.description: Required DLL plugins, validated against dll_db. At most one dependency per repository. The launcher requires explicit enablement and loads dependencies first.
